buttons.label: Uses Gmail modify access to read, label, archive, trash and send on request. No background tasks. Core holds OAuth credentials. Mail bodies remain transient; only send command IDs and outcomes are retained.
If sending is unconfirmed, check Sent in Gmail before composing again. Retrying the same command never sends twice.
